headline: Building intelligent healthcare solutions that automate clinical workflows, enhance decision-making, and enable clinicians to spend more time delivering exceptional patient care.
intro: Hi, I’m Faeliq. With 8 years of experience in Operations Management and a background in Data Science, I’m building AI-powered solutions that rethink how healthcare works. I’m driven by curiosity—breaking down complex systems, uncovering inefficiencies, and transforming them into intelligent automation that empowers clinicians, improves patient care, and lays the foundation for the next generation of healthcare technology.
